_comment: Bases: discoveries, production, the people who run them, and the troubles that come of being found. scripts/bases.gd runs the raids themselves. See docs/events.md.

cove_rumour.title: A turtler's tale
cove_rumour.text: An old turtle hunter in the tavern, paid in rum, tells of an anchorage no chart shows: deep water, good shelter, and nobody for leagues.

choices.text: Buy him another and hear where (20 gold)
choices.result: He draws it on the table in spilled rum. You copy it carefully.
He's still telling it to someone else as you leave.

base_books_short.title: Short in the books
base_books_short.text: The accounts from {base} don't add up. Someone is skimming the treasury, and it's hard not to look at whoever runs the place.

choices.result: The skimming stops. The mood at {base} sours a little.
choices.fail_result: The letter goes unanswered, and more goes missing.

choices.text: Let it go: a manager has to live

base_garrison_brawl.title: Trouble at {base}
base_garrison_brawl.text: Word from {base}: the garrison has been drinking and fighting, and two men are dead over a game of dice. They're bored, and short of everything.

choices.text: Send money for their wages and a cask of rum

choices.result: Order of a sort. The garrison is two men lighter and no happier.

base_bumper_crop.title: A good harvest
base_bumper_crop.text: The fields at {base} have done better than anyone hoped. The storehouse is filling with sugar.

choices.result: Thirty more hogsheads, waiting for you.

base_fishermen.title: Seen
base_fishermen.text: A fishing boat put into the cove at {base} for water and saw everything: the guns, the stores, your prizes at the dock. It sails for {port_name} tomorrow.

choices.result: They take the money. Whether they keep quiet is another matter.
Fishermen don't come home, and nobody hears about the cove from them.
By the end of the month every tavern in {port_name} will know where you hide.

base_hurricane.title: Hurricane at {base}
base_hurricane.text: A hurricane has torn through {base}. Roofs are gone, the dock is half under water, and the garrison spent the night in the hills.

choices.text: Send money to rebuild at once
choices.result: Timber and nails on the next sloop. The damage is made good.

base_manager_ambition.title: {base} has a new master
base_manager_ambition.text: Your manager at {base} has been telling the garrison that the cove is better off without you, and the garrison is listening. A letter arrives: the base will pay you no more tribute.

choices.text: Sail there and take it back
choices.result: Your arrival is enough: the garrison hand you the manager in irons.
choices.fail_result: The garrison stands with their new master. {base} is theirs now.

base_deserters_arrive.title: Men looking for a home
base_deserters_arrive.text: A boatload of deserters from a {nation_adj} warship has turned up at {base}, asking to join the garrison.

choices.result: Six more trained hands, and the navy will be looking for them.
They row off toward the next cove along.
